source.note: Mage.glb from the pack's GitHub mirror, pinned to commit 672074b (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg). The rig carries every alternative prop; kept 2H_Staff, dropped Spellbook, Spellbook_open and 1H_Wand. 31 of 76 clips kept (the knight's locomotion, hit, death, dodge, sit and interact set, with the four Spellcast clips and the 2H staff melee clips in place of the 1H sword set; ranged, dual-wield, unarmed and lie-down clips dropped). attack is Spellcast_Shoot, cast is the looping Spellcasting. Height 1.76 m to the hat tip: the same scale as the knight (1.6 m to the helmet top; same rig, head bone 0.805 m vs 0.731 m at 1.6 m, so x1.10), so the body matches the knight and the tall hat adds the rest; KayKit characters are chibi, and this keeps the head near a real size next to realistic props. Coloured on festival (magenta robe and hat, gold trim, violet cape) so it reads apart from the indigo steel-and-red knight.
